audit_2026_08_19_second_pass.scope: independent audit of the seven-new-concepts work; narrow-width shell top bar clipping
audit_2026_08_19_second_pass.detail: Second-pass independent audit 2026-08-19 (browser-measured, ConceptHub-served pages): at 760/900px page widths the shared shell top bar content (~962px) exceeded the frame and clipped the demo control cluster (Scenarios, theme select, motion, panel toggles). Fixed concept-locally: @container pmx (max-width: 990px) wraps .pmx-topbar to two rows and hides decorative .pmx-model chips; shared pm-shell.css is untouched (frozen with concepts 01-04). Re-verified at exactly 760px and 900px page width: scrollWidth==clientWidth, all six shell controls inside the frame rect, theme select exposes all 8 themes and is clickable, topbar height 60.5px with no overlap of stage content, zero console errors. Standalone narrow (625px frame) also passes with the width select reachable.
audit_2026_08_19_second_pass.shell_toggle_icon_fix: User-reported blank top-bar buttons: the shell demo toggles (reduced motion, side/chat/bottom panel) carry bare SVGs with no intrinsic size and no shared CSS rule sizes them, so they painted 0x0 (pre-existing shared-shell markup issue, identical in 01-04). Fixed concept-locally: .pmx-controls [data-shell-motion] > svg, .pmx-controls [data-shell-toggle] > svg { inline-size: 14px; block-size: 14px; }. Browser-verified on all seven concepts: rule live in CSSOM, all four icons 14x14, Scenarios icon unchanged (14x14), toggle buttons still function, zero console errors.
